chilli_cercospora.symptoms:
Circular, brown spots: Initial symptoms appear as small, circular brown spots with light grey centers on leaves. 
 Shot-hole appearance: The central portion of the spots may drop out, leaving a shot-hole appearance. 
 Spot enlargement and coalescence: Spots can grow larger and combine with each other, eventually covering the entire leaf. 
 Leaf yellowing and premature drop: Infected leaves may turn yellow and fall off prematurely. 
 Stem and fruit infection: In severe cases, the fungus can also infect stems and fruits.
chilli_cercospora.remedies: Use beneficial bacteria like Bacillus subtilis. Perform Crop rotation and remove debris.
chilli_cercospora.pesticides: Fungicides such as propiconazole, Samartha, Dr Blight, KZEB.

chilli_healthy.symptoms: No disease symptoms; healthy plants exhibit vibrant green leaves, robust stems, and well-formed fruits.
chilli_healthy.remedies: Not applicable; focus on preventive cultural practices like crop rotation and sanitation.
chilli_healthy.pesticides: Not applicable; use preventive measures like neem oil for general pest deterrence.

chilli_leafSpot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves that turn dark brown to black with a yellow halo; spots may coalesce, causing leaf drop.
chilli_leafSpot.remedies: Use beneficial bacteria like Bacillus subtilis. Perform Crop rotation and remove debris.
chilli_leafSpot.pesticides: Fungicides such as propiconazole, Samartha, Dr Blight, KZEB.

chilli_murdaComplex.symptoms: Leaf curling, stunted growth, reduced fruit size, caused by a complex of viruses transmitted by whiteflies.
chilli_murdaComplex.remedies: Control whitefly populations, use reflective mulches, plant resistant varieties, remove infected plants, weeds, use insect-proof nets.
chilli_murdaComplex.pesticides: Insecticides like imidacloprid or neem oil

chilli_nutritional.symptoms: Yellowing leaves, stunted growth, poor fruit set due to nutrient deficiencies (e.g., nitrogen, potassium).
chilli_nutritional.remedies: Conduct soil tests, apply balanced fertilizers, ensure proper irrigation; foliar sprays for quick correction.
chilli_nutritional.pesticides: Not applicable; focus on nutrient management.

chilli_powderyMildew.symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves, stems, and fruits; yellowing, curling leaves; premature leaf drop.
chilli_powderyMildew.remedies: Improve air circulation, avoid overhead irrigation, remove infected parts. Use beneficial bacteria like Bacillus subtilis.
chilli_powderyMildew.pesticides: Fungicides like triadimefon, propiconazole, TEBUSUL, SULVET, HEXA 5 PLUS.

chilli_whitefly.symptoms: Yellowing leaves, sticky honeydew, sooty mold, stunted growth; whiteflies visible on leaf undersides.
chilli_whitefly.remedies: Use yellow sticky traps, introduce natural predators like ladybugs, apply reflective mulches. Remove weeds, use insect-proof nets.
chilli_whitefly.pesticides: Insecticides like imidacloprid, pyriproxyfen, or neem oil.

grape_blackRot.symptoms: Small, tan to brown spots on leaves with dark margins; black, shriveled berries; lesions on shoots.
grape_blackRot.remedies: Remove infected plant parts, improve air circulation, avoid overhead irrigation.
grape_blackRot.pesticides: Fungicides like myclobutanil, captan (consult local extension for approved options).

grape_esca.symptoms: Leaf discoloration, tiger-stripe patterns, wood necrosis, dieback of vines.
grape_esca.remedies: Prune affected wood, avoid wounding vines, monitor for early symptoms.
grape_esca.pesticides: No specific pesticides; sodium arsenite can be used.

grape_healthy.symptoms: No disease symptoms; healthy vines with green leaves, strong shoots, and well-formed clusters.
grape_healthy.remedies: Not applicable; focus on preventive practices like pruning and irrigation management.
grape_healthy.pesticides: Not applicable; use preventive sprays like sulfur for general fungal protection.

grape_leafBlight.symptoms: Irregular brown to black spots on leaves, leaf yellowing, premature defoliation.
grape_leafBlight.remedies: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, use drip irrigation.
grape_leafBlight.pesticides: Fungicides like copper-based products or mancozeb.

maize_cercosporaLeafSpot.symptoms: Small, tan to grey spots with brown borders on leaves; spots coalesce, causing leaf blight.
maize_cercosporaLeafSpot.remedies: Plant resistant hybrids, remove crop debris, use crop rotation; tillage to bury residue.

maize_commonRust.symptoms: Orange to rust-colored pustules on leaves, reducing photosynthesis; severe cases cause yield loss.
maize_commonRust.remedies: Plant resistant hybrids, monitor early, avoid dense planting. Crop rotation, remove debris.

maize_healthy.symptoms: No disease symptoms; healthy plants with green leaves, strong stalks, and full ears.
maize_healthy.remedies: Maintain soil fertility, monitor pests, use resistant hybrids; focus on preventive practices like crop rotation.
maize_healthy.pesticides: Not applicable; use preventive fungicides if risk is high.

maize_northernLeafBlight.symptoms: Long, grey-green to tan lesions on leaves, often with a cigar shape; reduces photosynthesis.
maize_northernLeafBlight.remedies: Plant resistant hybrids, remove crop debris, use crop rotation.

potato_earlyBlight.symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings (‘target spots’) on leaves; leaf yellowing and drop.
potato_earlyBlight.remedies: Plant resistant varieties, remove infected debris, use crop rotation.

potato_healthy.symptoms: No disease symptoms; healthy plants with green foliage, strong tubers, and no lesions.
potato_healthy.remedies: Not applicable; focus on preventive practices like crop rotation.
potato_healthy.pesticides: Not applicable; use preventive fungicides if needed.

potato_lateBlight.symptoms: Water-soaked spots on leaves turning purple-brown; white fungal growth on leaf undersides; tuber rot.
potato_lateBlight.remedies: Remove infected plants, use drip irrigation, plant resistant varieties.
potato_lateBlight.pesticides: Fungicides like chlorothalonil, mancozeb, phosphorous acid.

rice_bacterialBlight.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaves turning yellow to grey-white; leaf drying and wilting; stem blackening.
rice_bacterialBlight.remedies: Use resistant varieties, avoid excessive nitrogen, remove infected debris.

rice_brownSpot.symptoms: Small, brown to grey spots on leaves, often with yellow halos; severe cases cause leaf drop.
rice_brownSpot.remedies: Use resistant varieties, improve soil fertility, avoid water stress. Balanced fertilization, remove debris.

rice_healthy.symptoms: No disease symptoms; healthy plants with green leaves, strong tillers, and full panicles.
rice_healthy.remedies: Not applicable; focus on preventive practices like field sanitation.
rice_healthy.pesticides: Not applicable; use preventive fungicides if needed.

rice_leafSmut.symptoms: Small, black spots on leaves; severe infections cause leaf distortion and reduced yield.
rice_leafSmut.remedies: Use resistant varieties, remove infected debris, avoid overhead irrigation.

tomato_bacterialSpot.disease: Bacterial Spot and Speck of Tomato
tomato_bacterialSpot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves turning dark brown to black with yellow halos; fruit spots with raised edges.
tomato_bacterialSpot.remedies: Use disease-free seeds, avoid overhead irrigation, remove infected plants. Cultural: Crop rotation, sanitation.

tomato_earlyBlight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings on leaves; leaf yellowing and drop; stem lesions.
tomato_earlyBlight.remedies: Plant resistant varieties, remove debris, use crop rotation. Sanitation, proper spacing.

tomato_healthy.symptoms: No disease symptoms; healthy plants with green leaves, strong stems, and well-formed fruits.
tomato_healthy.remedies: Not applicable; focus on preventive practices like crop rotation.
tomato_healthy.pesticides: Not applicable; use preventive fungicides if needed.

tomato_lateBlight.symptoms: Water-soaked spots on leaves turning purple-brown; white fungal growth on leaf undersides; brown fruit rot.
tomato_lateBlight.remedies: Remove infected plants, use drip irrigation, plant resistant varieties. Crop rotation, sanitation.
tomato_lateBlight.pesticides: Fungicides like chlorothalonil, mancozeb, phosphorous acid.

tomato_leafMold.symptoms: Yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces; greyish-white fungal growth on undersides; leaf drop.
tomato_leafMold.remedies: Improve air circulation, avoid overhead irrigation, remove infected leaves. Sanitation, proper spacing.
tomato_leafMold.pesticides: Fungicides like chlorothalonil, copper-based products (consult local extension).

tomato_mosaicVirus.symptoms: Mottled leaves with yellow and green patches; stunted growth; distorted fruits.
tomato_mosaicVirus.remedies: Use virus-free seeds, remove infected plants, control aphids. Sanitation, remove weeds. No chemical control for viruses.
tomato_mosaicVirus.pesticides: Not applicable; control insect vectors with insecticides like neem oil.

tomato_septoriaLeafSpot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves turning grey with black margins; yellowing and leaf drop.
tomato_septoriaLeafSpot.remedies: Remove infected leaves, use drip irrigation, plant resistant varieties. Crop rotation, sanitation.

tomato_spiderMites.symptoms: Yellow stippling on leaves, fine webbing, leaf bronzing, and drop; tiny mites visible with a lens.
tomato_spiderMites.remedies: Increase humidity, use water sprays to dislodge mites, introduce predatory mites. Maintain plant health, remove infested leaves. Use predatory mites.

tomato_targetSpot.symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings on leaves; fruit lesions with sunken centers.
tomato_targetSpot.remedies: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, use drip irrigation. Crop rotation, sanitation.

tomato_yellowLeafCurlVirus.symptoms: Upward leaf curling, yellowing, stunted growth, reduced fruit yield; transmitted by whiteflies.
tomato_yellowLeafCurlVirus.remedies: Control whiteflies with sticky traps, use reflective mulches, plant resistant varieties. Remove weeds, use insect-proof nets. No chemical control for viruses.
tomato_yellowLeafCurlVirus.pesticides: Insecticides like imidacloprid for whitefly control.
